documents.notes: 'Completing your UCAS application' (URL /apply/how redirects here): deadline for 2027 entry 15 October 2026; My Cambridge Application by 22 October 2026. The page states the documents rule 'For 2027 entry'. Not drafted: My Cambridge Application (a second online form completed after UCAS; no separate vocabulary kind besides the UCAS application), extenuating-circumstances information. Course-specific admission assessments (e.g. for Computer Science) are on the course page, which was not read for this question.

items.quote: You must apply to Cambridge through UCAS .
You will need to write a personal statement as part of your UCAS application.
You may need to provide documents as part of your application, such as a transcript (a certified record of your academic achievements).
items.condition: when Cambridge requires it; for 2027 entry such documents are provided via My Cambridge Application or the College, not UCAS

items.quote: Your school or college will need to submit a reference for you.
